title: Inbound and outbound AI voice agents, connected to every client's CRM
summary: For a voice agent agency, we build the AI receptionists, outbound callers and follow-up agents it delivers to its clients, each wired into that client's CRM, calendar and phone number.
problem: The agency sells AI phone systems to clients in very different industries, and each one needs its own CRM, calendar, number and compliance setup. Its lead-generation division also needed new leads called within seconds, not hours. Building every agent from scratch didn't scale.
overviewHeading: Agents that pick up the phone.
overview: We standardised a three-assistant architecture (receptionist, outbound and follow-up) that we deploy per client, with telephony, pipelines, booking and reporting included, so a new client goes live quickly and consistently.

built.title: AI phone systems
built.detail: Vapi assistants for reception, outbound calling and follow-up, each connected to the client's CRM, calendar and phone number.

built.title: Three-assistant setup
built.detail: Receptionist, outbound and follow-up assistants standardised across clients, with custom tools, live call transfer and a backup line.

built.title: Outreach pipelines
built.detail: 12-stage GoHighLevel AI outreach pipelines with outcome-based workflow branches.

built.title: Telephony
built.detail: Twilio subaccounts, local numbers and A2P registration for every client.

built.title: Instant lead calls
built.detail: A Facebook lead form triggers an instant outbound call from a Vapi agent that works the new lead.

built.title: Outbound triggers
built.detail: Calls also start when a contact is tagged in GoHighLevel or a lead list is uploaded to a shared sheet.

built.title: Calendar booking
built.detail: Live availability checks and booking through GoHighLevel and HubSpot calendars, plus multi-touch follow-up cadences.

built.title: Many industries
built.detail: Agents delivered for credit services, financial services, insurance, travel, real estate education, environmental services and roofing.

built.title: End-of-call summaries
built.detail: When a call ends, the contact is found or created, the transcript is analysed, an AI summary is written to the contact and the opportunity moves to the right stage.

built.title: Voice AI dashboard
built.detail: Total and active calls, minutes, assistants, success and connection rate, average call length and quality indicators.

built.title: Handover and reporting
built.detail: Handover documentation for every build and monthly per-client reports.

built.title: Voice and model stack
built.detail: Deepgram Nova 2 for transcription, GPT-4.1 for reasoning and a natural Vapi voice, at around $0.10 per minute.
